title: Spec: Gherkin for controlled-vocabulary findings
description: Spec-first. Scenarios: an unapproved word surfaces a finding with the approved alternative when one exists; one-meaning-per-word violations (same word used with two meanings) surface; approved technical names (nouns) are accepted even when their everyday verb form is unapproved. Watch it fail before implementation.
